Article text:
Reliably aligning LLMs is impossible in principle sean goedecke
Reliably aligning LLMs is impossible in principle
Powerful AI is unpredictable. Your robotic butler may suddenly decide to kill you 1 for no comprehensible reason, in the same way that Bing’s helpful chat AI would sometimes try to blackmail or seduce its users. “Solving alignment” means understanding even superintelligent AI minds well enough to be confident they’ll never do that. As I see it, solving alignment for LLMs isn’t just impossible, it’s incoherent: we can’t even articulate what it would look like to succeed.
